instruction.name: xvfcmp.sule.s
instruction.description: Compare corresponding single precision elements in `a` and `b`, save the comparison result (all ones if ULE(Unordered or Less than or Equal), all zeros otherwise) into `dst`. An exception is raised for QNaN.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.
